requirements_summary: Workload: chat-first (multi-turn), embeddings for semantic search, occasional reranking for batch pipelines
Latency targets: median <120ms, p95 <250ms for non-heavy system prompts; tail predictability is top priority
Throughput: initial steady-state ~120 qps for embeddings search traffic; bursts up to 400 qps during peak hours
Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget but growth plan; wants unit economics and ability to switch to Dedicated for predictability
Model preferences: open-models acceptable; want Redwood-verified profiles and guidance on quantized variants
Failover/routing: need routing policy for cost-sensitive vs latency-sensitive customers; fallback model for capacity events
Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), SOC2 evidence, KMS integration, audit logs with 12–24 month retention option, optional EU data residency for specific customers
workshop_outcomes: Batching: recommended dynamic batch window with target batch sizes 8–16 for chat encoder/decoder mix; expect 20–35% token-cost reduction with negligible median latency impact
Caching: implement prefix caching for FAQ/KB prompts and KV-cache reuse across multi-turn sessions; estimated hit-rate target 45% on FAQ flows -> ~18% cost savings
Quantization profiles: test path: fp16 baseline -> int8 (fast) -> int4 (high compression). Workshop agreed to run int8 on Dedicated as initial tradeoff; int4 subject to quality regression tests
Unit economics: baseline Hosted run-rate estimated $2.40 per 1M tokens (current), projected $1.45–$1.70 per 1M after batching+cache+int8 on Dedicated at projected throughput
POC metrics to capture: tokens/sec, median/p95 latency by route, cache hit-rate, cost per session, model latency tail distribution, quality delta (ROUGE/embedding cosine / manual evals)
Operational asks: per-route tracing, token-level cost breakdown, alerting on cache hit-rate drops, canary rollout for quantized variants
poc_plan: Phase 1 (Hosted, 2 weeks): baseline profiling + instrumentation, capture token counts, latency, and cost metrics using sample production traces
Phase 2 (Hosted opt, 1 week): enable batching + prefix caching on Hosted to validate savings and latency impact
Phase 3 (Dedicated, 2 weeks): spin up reserved pool; test int8 quantized model variants, measure unit economics at target throughput
Phase 4 (Rollout prep): create runbook for migrating customers and rollback plan; finalize SOW and pricing commitment
